title: huberantha ceramensis
intro: Huberantha ceramensis, commonly known as Ceram-Plumeria or Plumeria ceramensis, is a species of flowering plant in the family Apocynaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and acting as an antioxidant, potentially helping to protect against cell damage and oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Huberantha ceramensis include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiparasitic activities, which may be beneficial in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
